The four astrology signs changing their career / money story right now ⤵️

👉These specific placements are being asked to rewrite their story around money, career, their purpose and studies.

1️⃣ CANCER RISINGS: 

You’re being asked to expand the ways you earn income. This could be a new entrepreneurship venture or you’re feeling called to work for yourself or rewrite your money store. Money gets to be fun to make. Earning gets to be easy. Business and earning is simply reciprocity. Give and take. The buyer vs the seller. It’s an exchange and nothing more. Money is a neutral thing, but it’s our mindset around what money represents that changes everything. follow your excitements and pursue what you’re passionate about right now. Do what you love and the money will follow! 

2️⃣ Sagittarius Risings: 

You’re rewriting your belief systems and diving deeper into your studies. The 9th house is the house of astrology, religion, spirituality, learning and personal development so you might be exploring a course, certification program, going back to school or traveling internationally. This is the year where your mindset can completely change! Commit to your practice. 

3️⃣ Pisces Risings:

Your job is changing. You might have some challenges with coworkers, or just the everyday drudgery of your day job or the ways in which you’re of service to others in work. You’re being challenged to think bigger foe yourself! Stop limiting yourself to what you can do. Expand your work, better support others and be of service in a way that makes you come alive! 

4️⃣ Scorpio Risings: you’re rewriting your reputation. What you’ve been doing for your career isn’t cutting it anymore and you might be changing your brand voice, public image or changing your career entirely! You’re being asked to follow a call that’s bigger than you. And that will require you to dream bigger for your career. These next 2 years are the years to GO for it

items.title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio in Birth Charts
items.summary:
A detailed exploration of what Venus retrograde in Scorpio means in birth charts, primarily by looking through 29 different celebrity case studies, with astrologers Skye Barclay and Chris Brennan.

During the episode, we examine not only how this placement manifests natally, but what happened when these figures experienced their 8-year Venus retrograde recurrences. By tracing these transits, we highlight the major turning points, delayed successes, and public reckonings that literally played out in their lives and careers in real time.

Our research uncovered some profound archetypal patterns surrounding what it means for a retrograde planet to be in its detriment. We dive deep into concepts like "struggle love," the "sympathetic villain," and the myths of Medusa and Lucifer, exploring how the individuals in our case studies challenged conventional beauty standards, subverted gender norms, and navigated the darker, more taboo facets of Venus.

Skye is the author of an awesome new book titled 2026 Venus Retrograde: A Dance of Daggers & Delights, which you can get in print or PDF on her website: 

https://www.skyeastrology.com/venusrx

This is episode 552 of The Astrology Podcast.
